caption: The video showcases two transparent plastic cups standing side by side against a dark backdrop featuring a soft, blurry orange-red glow centered between them. Each cup has a vertical green paper strip fixed to its front face, marked with a short horizontal dark ink line at roughly the same height. The left cup contains a clear liquid filled to about the level of the ink mark, along with a crinkled transparent plastic liner. The right cup holds a clear liquid whose surface sits above the ink mark, containing a transparent plastic liner that encases two oval, mottled green-brown fruit pieces, with additional crinkled plastic or ice-like material visible near the rim. The cups, green strips, ink marks, liquid surfaces, and fruit pieces remain essentially in place throughout, with no clear translation, expansion, or deformation. The background glow and cup outlines stay steady, while subtle shifts in highlights and refraction ripple across the transparent liners and liquid surfaces.
